TERMINATION.self_included: YES: the nested run executes EVERY tests/custody/*.test.ts, d1-cert-event-termination.test.ts included. Recursion is bounded by UELLIX_D1_TERMINATION_NESTED=1: in that mode the file runs A, B (minus the further nested run) and C. The marker is honoured only when the test runs inside a d1-termination-* copy (asserted), so it cannot disable the check in the repository or in CI.
TERMINATION.candidate_derivation: tests/custody/support/d1-termination-repo.ts deriveSourceCandidate(): a content-neutral merge (GitHub refs/pull/N/merge, tree == a parent) is peeled to the parent it copies; then, if that head's whole diff from its parent is exactly the event file derived from the parent, the candidate is the parent (CANDIDATE_PLUS_EVENT), else the head (CANDIDATE). Unit-tested on real repos: author branch, certifier successor, GitHub merge of each, content-changing merge (not peeled), event + edit, event for another commit.
TERMINATION.wrong_candidate_cases: An event for a SIBLING of the candidate (commit-tree: same tree, same parent, different commit) and for the candidate's parent, asserted distinct from the candidate; plus wrong path, wrong tree, FAIL, blocking>0, self-certification, other digest: each NOT_READY with exactly [PMR-9].
TERMINATION.schedule_event_ordering: B: schedule (in the candidate) -> candidate -> event: effective schedule identical at candidate and successor, N10 READY_FOR_HUMAN_CONFIRMATION. C: candidate -> event -> a VALID schedule change: the schedule re-derives, N10 NOT_READY with exactly [PMR-9].
